title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and use face masks over time under social influence, information, policy interventions, availability, and (optionally) epidemic risk.

interactions.name: social_contact_and_observation
interactions.description: Agents meet at locations or via network ties; they may transmit infection and observe peers' mask use, affecting future adoption.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask mandates; noncompliance can lead to denial of entry or fines.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Media and policy announcements shape trust and risk perception; social network exchanges update beliefs.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Agents buy masks from retailers subject to price, subsidies, and stock availability.

metrics.name: overall_mask_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of the population wearing a mask at each time step.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_by_group
metrics.description: Mask-wearing rate segmented by age, income, trust level, or location type.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Days until overall adoption first reaches 70%.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of agents complying when a mandate is active.

metrics.name: average_compliance_duration
metrics.description: Mean consecutive days an adopter continues wearing a mask before dropping.

metrics.name: masks_purchased
metrics.description: Cumulative number of masks purchased over time.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of fines or entry refusals due to noncompliance.

metrics.name: incidence_rate
metrics.description: New infections per day (if disease dynamics are modeled).

metrics.name: infections_averted
metrics.description: Difference in cumulative infections compared to a no-mask counterfactual.
